Users can access their applications remotely from anywhere and on a variety of devices. Although the applications appear to run on the users' local device, they are centralized on Azure’s protected, reliable platform. For more information, please visit the Azure RemoteApp page. Body.Markdown:
Generally available on December 11, 2014, Azure RemoteApp delivers Windows applications from Microsoft Azure and helps IT professionals bring scale, agility, and global access to their business applications.

Users can access their applications remotely from anywhere and on a variety of devices. Although the applications appear to run on the users' local device, they are centralized on Azure’s protected, reliable platform.

For more information, please visit the Azure RemoteApp page. For pricing details, please visit the Azure RemoteApp Pricing Details page.

Note : Any Azure RemoteApp instances created during the public preview period will continue to function as they do today. These instances will automatically transition to a 30-day free trial on December 11, 2014.
